label: TP
reason: User input flows from request.getParameterNames() into param, which is passed to doSomething and stored in bar. Bar is directly concatenated into the LDAP filter string (line 73) without sanitization, enabling LDAP injection. While the XSS sink (line 99) applies encodeForHTML, this mitigates XSS but leaves the LDAP filter vulnerable to injection via the same data flow.

evidence.note: Filter string directly interpolates bar (user input) without escaping
User input captured via getParameterNames and assigned to param/bar
